title: Backtest Brief
description: A comprehensive summary of a backtest or live trading run.

git_commit.description: The git commit hash at the time of the run.

run_seed.description: Seed used for all random number generators.

strategy_params.description: A snapshot of the parameters and configuration used to define the strategy for this run. This includes any user-defined parameters, feature configurations, and rule sets.

additionalProperties.description: Scalar value (number, string, boolean, or null).

overall_performance.description: Run-level performance metrics in the portfolio's base currency.

total_pnl.description: Sum of all trade profits and losses (net, after costs).

total_pnl_movement.description: Sum of all trade profits and losses from pure mid-to-mid price movement, excluding all transaction costs.

total_costs.description: Sum of all transaction costs across all trades.

cost_breakdown.description: Breakdown of total transaction costs by category.

by_side_total_pnl.description: Total PnL broken down by trade side.

final_equity.description: Ending equity of the portfolio after all trades.

risk_snapshot.description: Key risk metrics based on trade outcomes.

avg_win.description: Average net PnL of winning trades (after costs).

avg_loss.description: Average net PnL of losing trades (after costs).

avg_win_movement.description: Average PnL movement of winning trades (mid-to-mid, excluding costs).

avg_loss_movement.description: Average PnL movement of losing trades (mid-to-mid, excluding costs).

max_loss.description: Largest single losing trade (most negative PnL).

equity_stats.description: Statistics related to the portfolio equity curve.

equity_curve.description: Time series of portfolio equity (timestamp, value) pairs.

prefixItems.description: Equity value at the given timestamp.

drawdown_curve.description: Time series of portfolio drawdown (timestamp, value) pairs.

prefixItems.description: Drawdown value at the given timestamp.

max_drawdown.description: The largest peak-to-trough drop in equity.

dd_duration_bars.description: The duration in bars of the longest drawdown period.

streaks.description: Analysis of consecutive winning and losing trades.

current_streak.description: Current consecutive winning or losing trades.

holding_time.description: Metrics related to trade holding times.

median_secs.description: Median trade holding time in seconds.

total_costs.description: Total sum of all trading costs (spread, commission, slippage).

spread.description: Total cost due to bid-ask spread.

average_gross_exposure.description: Average absolute value of open position size during the run.

peak_gross_exposure.description: Maximum absolute value of open position size during the run.

n_trades.description: Number of trades in this regime.

data_quality.description: Summary of data quality checks performed on the input data.

loader_flags.description: Flags or warnings generated during data loading (e.g., missing files, format issues).

index_monotonic_increasing.description: True if the data index (timestamps) is strictly increasing.

duplicate_bars_count.description: Number of duplicate timestamp entries found in the data.

nan_counts.description: Count of NaN (Not a Number) values per data column.

has_nans.description: True if any NaN values were found in the data.

signal_quality_analysis.description: Analysis of signal quality, persistence, and duration statistics.

signal_persistence_pct.description: Percentage of bars where the signal is non-flat (i.e., persistent state).

avg_signal_duration_bars.description: Average number of consecutive bars a non-flat signal persists.

model_analysis.description: Analysis of model performance, including opportunity cost and stop-loss effectiveness.

avg_pnl_left_on_table_at_tp.description: Average profit left on the table at take-profit exits (difference between MFE and actual PnL for TP trades).

avg_loss_avoided_by_stop.description: Average loss avoided by stop-loss exits (difference between MAE and actual loss for SL trades).

provenance.description: Information about the origin and context of the run and data.

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this specific run.

strategy_name.description: Name of the strategy that was executed.

data_start.description: Start timestamp of the historical data used for the run.

data_end.description: End timestamp of the historical data used for the run.

symbols.description: List of trading symbols (instruments) included in the run.

app_version.description: Version of the trading platform application that performed the run.

git_commit.description: Git commit hash of the codebase at the time of the run.

run_seed.description: Seed value used for any random number generation to ensure reproducibility.

environment.description: Details of the execution environment where the run was performed.

dependency_versions.description: Key dependency names and their installed versions.

trades.description: A list of all executed trades, including entry, exit, and performance details.

side.description: The direction of the trade (long or short).

size.description: The size of the position in base currency units.

entry_time.description: Timestamp when the trade was entered.

exit_time.description: Timestamp when the trade was exited.

entry_price.description: Price at which the trade was entered.

exit_price.description: Price at which the trade was exited.

pnl.description: Net profit or loss of the trade in the portfolio's base currency (after all costs).

pnl_movement.description: The theoretical profit or loss from pure price movement, calculated from the mid-price at entry to the mid-price at exit, excluding all transaction costs.

r_multiple.description: Risk multiple (PnL / initial risk) for the trade.

mfe_currency.description: Maximum Favorable Excursion in currency units.

mae_currency.description: Maximum Adverse Excursion in currency units.

bars_held.description: Number of bars the trade was held open.

context_at_entry.description: Snapshot of strategy/regime context at trade entry.

strategy_features.description: Indicator values at entry keyed by feature name.

label.description: Active regime label after hysteresis adjustments.

confidence.description: Confidence assigned to the active regime label.

raw_label.description: Immediate label from rule evaluation before hysteresis adjustments.

allowed_sides.description: Sides permitted by policy given the active regime.

features.description: Additional regime features (ATR percentile, realized volatility, etc.).

bars_in_state.description: Number of completed bars the current label has been active.

cooldown_remaining.description: Bars remaining in the hysteresis cooldown before a new switch is allowed.

hysteresis.description: Snapshot of hysteresis counters for convenience.

bars_in_state.description: Same as bars_in_state, exposed for downstream convenience.

cooldown_remaining.description: Same as cooldown_remaining, exposed for downstream convenience.

context_at_exit.description: Snapshot of strategy/regime context at trade exit.

strategy_features.description: Indicator values at exit keyed by feature name.

label.description: Active regime label after hysteresis adjustments.

confidence.description: Confidence assigned to the active regime label.

raw_label.description: Immediate label from rule evaluation before hysteresis adjustments.

allowed_sides.description: Sides permitted by policy given the active regime.

bars_in_state.description: Number of completed bars the current label has been active.

cooldown_remaining.description: Bars remaining in the hysteresis cooldown before a new switch is allowed.

hysteresis.description: Snapshot of hysteresis counters for convenience.

bars_in_state.description: Same as bars_in_state, exposed for downstream convenience.

cooldown_remaining.description: Same as cooldown_remaining, exposed for downstream convenience.

cost_breakdown.description: Detailed breakdown of costs for this specific trade.

spread.description: Cost incurred due to bid-ask spread for this trade.

slippage.description: Cost incurred due to slippage for this trade.

skipped_trades.description: A list of potential trades that were not executed due to various filters or policies, along with their simulated counterfactual outcomes.

side.description: The intended direction of the skipped trade.

size.description: The intended size of the position.

entry_time.description: Timestamp when the trade would have been entered.

skip_reason.description: The reason the trade was skipped (e.g., 'blackout_period', 'rmm_filter', 'risk_cap').

counterfactual_pnl.description: Simulated PnL if the trade had been executed.

counterfactual_mfe_currency.description: Simulated Maximum Favorable Excursion in currency units.

counterfactual_mae_currency.description: Simulated Maximum Adverse Excursion in currency units.

filter_impact.description: Aggregated performance impact of skipped trades, categorized by the reason for skipping.

n_skipped.description: Number of trades skipped for this specific reason.

total_cf_pnl.description: Total counterfactual PnL if all trades skipped for this reason had been executed.

mean_cf_pnl.description: Mean counterfactual PnL for trades skipped for this reason.

median_cf_pnl.description: Median counterfactual PnL for trades skipped for this reason.

monte_carlo.description: Results and statistics from Monte Carlo simulations, if enabled.

mode.description: MC engine mode (e.g., bootstrap_trades, block_bootstrap_trades, bar_bootstrap, bar_resimulation).

trials.description: Number of Monte Carlo trials executed.

config.description: Echo of the configuration used to run Monte Carlo (e.g., jitter and perturbation).

final_equity.description: Distribution summary for final equity across trials.

total_pnl.description: Distribution summary for total PnL across trials.

max_drawdown.description: Distribution summary for max drawdown across trials.

win_rate.description: Distribution summary for win rate across trials.

risk.description: Risk metrics computed from tail distributions.

var_95.description: Value-at-Risk at 95% confidence for total PnL.

ruin_prob.description: Probability of final equity falling to or below zero (0–1).

time_under_water_mean.description: Mean fraction of bars under previous equity peak across trials (0–1).

exemplars.description: Representative equity paths from worst/median/best trials.

walk_forward.description: Results and performance metrics from walk-forward optimization, if enabled.

splits.description: List of train/test split results and chosen parameters.

parameter_search.description: Results from parameter optimization or search, if enabled.

additionalProperties.description: Top-level field of the best candidate.
Nested field of the best candidate.

results.description: All candidate parameter sets with scores.

items.description: A candidate parameter set and its score.

instrument_definitions.description: A snapshot of the instrument metadata used during the run, including details like point value, tick size, and commission model.

cost_model.description: The configuration of the cost model applied during the run (e.g., spread, commission, slippage settings).

fill_policy.description: The configuration of the order fill policy used during the run.

tie_break_policy.description: The configuration of the policy used to resolve simultaneous exit conditions (e.g., stop-loss vs. take-profit).

blackout_policy.description: The configuration of the trading blackout policy applied during the run.

blackout_utc.description: List of UTC blackout intervals or timestamps.

blackout_events.description: List of event identifiers that trigger blackout windows.

rmm_policy.description: Regime Market Manager (RMM) policy configuration that controls when trades are allowed based on market regimes.

policy.description: RMM policy settings including confidence thresholds.

regimes.description: List of defined market regimes with their conditions.

features_used.description: List of feature names used by the RMM for regime classification.

regime_labels.description: List of all possible regime labels.

min_confidence.description: Minimum confidence threshold for regime classification.

allowed_labels.description: List of regime labels that allow trading.

rem_policy.description: Risk Exit Manager (REM) policy configuration that controls stop losses, take profits, and other exit conditions.

stop_loss.description: Stop loss configuration including price offsets and conditions.

take_profit.description: Take profit configuration including price offsets and conditions.

stop_loss_pips.description: Human-readable stop loss distance in pips.

take_profit_pips.description: Human-readable take profit distance in pips.

average_trades_per_day.description: Average number of trades executed per day over the backtest period.

timing_buckets.description: Performance metrics bucketed by time of trade entry.

hour_of_day.description: Performance metrics grouped by the hour of the day (UTC).

additionalProperties.description: Performance metrics for a specific hour bucket.

n_trades.description: Number of trades that entered during this hour.

total_pnl.description: Total PnL for trades entered during this hour.

win_rate.description: Win rate for trades entered during this hour.

day_of_week.description: Performance metrics grouped by the day of the week (0=Monday).

additionalProperties.description: Performance metrics for a specific day of week bucket.

n_trades.description: Number of trades that entered during this day of week.

total_pnl.description: Total PnL for trades entered during this day of week.

win_rate.description: Win rate for trades entered during this day of week.

contrasts.description: Performance comparison between long and short trades.

avg_win.description: Average net PnL of winning long trades (after costs).

avg_loss.description: Average net PnL of losing long trades (after costs).

avg_win_movement.description: Average PnL movement of winning long trades (mid-to-mid, excluding costs).

avg_loss_movement.description: Average PnL movement of losing long trades (mid-to-mid, excluding costs).

avg_win.description: Average net PnL of winning short trades (after costs).

avg_loss.description: Average net PnL of losing short trades (after costs).

avg_win_gross.description: Average gross PnL of winning short trades (before costs).

avg_loss_gross.description: Average gross PnL of losing short trades (before costs).

stationarity.description: Stationarity tests on the PnL series.

adf_p_value.description: P-value from the Augmented Dickey-Fuller test. A low p-value (< 0.05) suggests the series is stationary.

kpss_p_value.description: P-value from the KPSS test. A high p-value (> 0.05) suggests the series is stationary.

feature_analysis.description: Analysis of features from trade entry contexts.

feature_correlation_matrix.description: Pearson correlation matrix of all numerical features available at trade entry.

additionalProperties.description: Correlation values for a specific feature against all other features.
Correlation coefficient between two features (values between -1 and 1).

checksums.description: Checksums of critical configuration files to ensure reproducibility and detect tampering.

config_snapshot_hash.description: SHA256 hash of the run configuration snapshot.

instrument_defs_hash.description: SHA256 hash of the instrument definitions used.

artifacts.description: Paths to run artifacts saved alongside the brief.

signals_path.description: Path to the saved signals file (e.g., signals.parquet).

rmm_spans_path.description: Path to the saved RMM spans file (e.g., rmm_spans.json).

stop_tp_candidates.description: Stop-loss and take-profit candidate levels from MFE/MAE analysis.

exit_efficiency.description: Analysis of exit timing efficiency by tracking price movement after each exit.

by_exit_reason.description: Exit efficiency metrics grouped by exit reason (take_profit, stop_loss, signal, etc.).

n_trades.description: Number of trades with this exit reason.

avg_opportunity_cost_10bar.description: Average additional profit/loss if position held 10 more bars.

avg_opportunity_cost_20bar.description: Average additional profit/loss if position held 20 more bars.

avg_opportunity_cost_50bar.description: Average additional profit/loss if position held 50 more bars.

premature_exit_rate.description: For TP exits: rate where price continued favorably by >2x profit.

false_stop_rate.description: For SL exits: rate where price reversed to profit after stop.

suboptimal_exit_rate.description: For signal exits: rate where price continued favorably by >1.5x profit.

optimal_hold_analysis.description: Analysis of optimal holding duration across all trades.

current_avg_pnl.description: Current average PnL per trade with actual exits.

if_held_10_bars.description: Hypothetical avg PnL if all trades held 10 more bars.

if_held_20_bars.description: Hypothetical avg PnL if all trades held 20 more bars.

if_held_50_bars.description: Hypothetical avg PnL if all trades held 50 more bars.

dynamic_rem_metrics.description: Statistics from DynamicREM position management actions during the backtest.

breakeven_triggers.description: Number of times breakeven stop was triggered (stop moved to entry price).

partial_exits_triggered.description: Number of partial exit orders executed at target R-multiples.

trailing_stop_activations.description: Number of times trailing stop was activated and moved.

volatility_tightenings.description: Number of times stop was tightened due to low volatility conditions.

field_definitions.description: Auto-generated descriptions for all fields within this brief, useful for programmatic interpretation and UI generation.

recommendations.description: Automated recommendations generated by the AI module based on diagnostic rules and detected flaws.

id.description: Unique identifier for the recommendation type.

rule.description: The rule or logic that triggered the recommendation.

regime_summary.description: Summary counts and metadata relating to RMM regimes observed during the run.

regime_labels.description: List of regime labels defined by the RMM.

allowed_labels.description: Labels the RMM policy allows for trading.

regime_counts.description: Counts of trades per regime label.

additionalProperties.description: Count of trades executed in this regime.

n_skipped_trades.description: Number of skipped trades due to policies (RMM, caps, etc).

n_long_skipped.description: Number of long trades skipped by policy.

n_short_skipped.description: Number of short trades skipped by policy.

n_allowed_regimes.description: Count of regimes explicitly allowed by the RMM policy.

n_active_regimes.description: Number of regimes observed during the run.

n_trades_in_allowed_regimes.description: Number of trades that occurred while the regime was allowed by RMM.

n_trades_in_disallowed_regimes.description: Number of trades that occurred in regimes not allowed by RMM.

policy_effects.description: High-level counts describing the effects of policy filters (RMM, caps) on trade execution.

n_trades.description: Number of executed trades after policy filtering.

n_skipped_trades.description: Number of potential trades skipped by policies.

n_long_skipped.description: Number of long trades skipped by policy.

n_short_skipped.description: Number of short trades skipped by policy.
